title: Range Sum Query - Mutable
description: Calculate the sum of elements in a range [left, right] and update elements in the array using a Binary Indexed Tree (Fenwick Tree) for O(log n) efficiency.
pseudocode:
1. function update(i, delta):
2.   for (; i < n; i += i & -i) tree[i] += delta
3. function query(i):
4.   for (sum = 0; i > 0; i -= i & -i) sum += tree[i]
5.   return sum

steps.note: Initializing BIT with array [1, 2, 3]. Tree array size is 4 (1-indexed).
Updating index 1 with value 1: tree[1]+=1, tree[2]+=1, tree[4] skip
Updating index 2 with value 2: tree[2]+=2, tree[4] skip
